Kylord Studios presents

NeutronConquest

Skirmish at Blackwater Crossing. Land your Command Ship, dig crystal, build a base and an army, and destroy their Command Center before they destroy yours.

Tip: turn your phone sideways for a wider view of the battlefield.

Prototype 0.5. Bigger maps and lakes, a Shipyard with eight warships, Command Center level 2 for a 120-unit army, and a new battle score.

How to play

  1. Land. You start with one Command Ship and nothing else. Tap the map to fly it, find open ground near glowing crystal, and press Deploy. It becomes your Command Center and cannot take off again.
  2. Get paid. Build a Refinery from the Base tab. It comes with a Harvester that digs crystal and carries it back. That is where every credit comes from, so protect it.
  3. Build. The Refinery comes first. After it you can build a War Factory (tanks and carriers), a Barracks (troops) and an Airstrip (planes). Artillery unlocks once you have both a War Factory and an Airstrip. Every extra War Factory, Barracks or Airstrip builds another unit at the same time. New buildings go within a few tiles of ones you already own.
  4. Command. Tap a unit to select it, or press Army to select everything. Then tap the ground to move, or tap an enemy to attack.
  5. Scout. You only see what your units see. Longshot and artillery out-range their own eyes, so send a Sparkplug or Kestrel ahead to find targets.
  6. Counter. Every unit has something it destroys and something that destroys it. Hold a card, or open the Armory, to see which.
  7. Win. Destroy the enemy Command Center. They land on the far side of the river, and three bridges lead there: north, centre and south.

Things worth knowing

  • Advance makes units fight anything they meet on the way. Rush makes them ignore enemies and keep driving, which is how you escape.
  • Forest hides units. Only a Sparkplug, or a unit almost touching them, can see into it. Squads standing in forest also take 40% less damage.
  • Squads thin out. A squad shows fewer soldiers as it takes losses. A Medic nearby brings them back.
  • Carriers. Jackrabbit and Coyote carry one squad, Bulldog, Tinker and Strongbox two, Breacher three. The Mule airlifts four squads or two vehicles across the river. Squads bail out if their carrier is about to blow.
  • Mines. An Armadillo that is standing still mines the roads around it. Enemy mines are invisible until a Sparkplug gets near. A Tinker clears them.
  • Hidden units look faded. Your Spotter and Coyote are invisible to the enemy while they look see-through to you.
  • Harvesters look after themselves. They dig and unload on their own, and when one is shot at it drives to the nearest friendly guns, then goes back to work.
  • Walls. After your Refinery is up, the Base tab has Wall: each section is built and placed one at a time, 50 credits each. Walls block both armies, so leave a gate. Enemies shoot them down when they are in the way.
  • Four-way war puts you on a map three times the size with three enemy armies: Red, Gold and Violet. They fight each other as well as you. Wipe out all three to win.
  • Lakes block ground units but not aircraft. A channel round the edge of the map joins them, so warships can sail to the enemy's lake.
  • Shipyard (Base tab) must be built on the lake shore. It builds the Navy: Skiff, Gull (anti-air), Barracuda, Marlin, Kraken rockets, Monitor, Albatross carrier and the Leviathan battleship.
  • Gold Pass: make a free gamertag, add friends who have the game open, and host or join live battles against them (1 vs 1, or a four-way war with computer armies in any empty seats).
  • Command Center level 2: once you have one of every base building, select your Command Center and press Level 2 (4,000 credits). Your army limit goes from 60 to 120.
  • SAM Sites fire homing missiles at aircraft and nothing else (look for the orange trails). A couple near your Command Center stops bombers flying straight in.
  • Repair. Tap one of your damaged buildings and press Repair. It mends quickly, even under fire, and costs credits while it works.
  • Retreat is not losing. Units parked beside your Command Center repair for free.
  • A red circle on the ground means a Thunderhead shell is about to land there. Move.
